name: Count-up company stats
purpose: Conveys company scale at a glance with three headline numbers that count up as they come into view.
description: Page-local block on /company: a small (24px, 20px mob) Inter H2 with one italic phrase and a grey lead, centred, then three square dark stat cards in a row, each with a label + short line at the top and a big number with suffix at the bottom. At <=767 the three 18.75rem squares stay in one row and scroll sideways (hidden scrollbar), as on the original.
